profile.headline: Software Engineer @ OmniSite | Software Design, .NET Web APIs, React.js
profile.summary:
I’m an ambitious and highly motivated Software Engineer with a strong foundation in both software development and quality assurance. Over the past six years, I’ve built a well-rounded perspective — starting with three years in QA, where I developed an eye for precision and reliability, and transitioning into nearly 4 years as a Software Engineer, where I focus on building efficient, scalable, and user-centered solutions.

I’m passionate about tackling challenging problems, learning continuously, and creating meaningful impact through technology. I thrive in environments that push me to grow, collaborate, and innovate — and I’m driven by the goal of making a real difference through the software I help build.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a full IoT software architecture from scratch, covering 10+ cloud services for device provisioning, telemetry ingestion, media uploads, alerting, and visualization.

• Developed full-stack applications using .NET (API + services), AWS cloud technologies, SQL/NoSQL databases, and React for interactive dashboards and real-time visualizations.

• Built real-time data pipelines for IoT state updates using MQTT, AWS IoT Core, SQS, Lambda, and Step Functions.

• Implemented media upload workflows, enabling devices to send images and video via pre-signed S3 URLs with cellular-optimized data usage.

• Owned projects end-to-end, including architecture design, system diagrams, storage design, backend API development, cloud infrastructure, and front-end UI/UX.

• Improved system performance and reliability through scalable service design, optimized queries, cache strategies, and event-driven patterns.

• Collaborated across engineering, QA, and product teams to align technical solutions with business goals and customer needs.

• Containerized and deployed microservices using Docker and Kubernetes in hybrid cloud environments.

positions.title: Team Lead
positions.description: Mobilized for one year in support of the Indiana Army National Guard's COVID-19 emergency response , providing statewide logistical, operational, and community support during the pandemic. Achieved the rank of Sergeant , leading, training, and supervising 8–12 soldiers in daily operations, task execution, and mission readiness. Mentored and developed soldiers through structured guidance, performance coaching, and formal class instruction, improving team capability and cohesion.

honors.title: Army Achievement Medal
honors.description: Recognized for stepping into a leadership role 3 ranks above my position to lead ~30 soldiers during a week without higher leadership. Managed platoon logistics—including meals, training schedules, and troop transportation—while teaching and mentoring soldiers, inspiring them to learn, adapt, and perform beyond expectations.
honors.issuer: Issued by LT. Dominic Lombardo · Aug 2022

honors.title: Army Achievement Medal
honors.description: Awarded during two week training exercise for taking on responsibilities above my pay grade by instructing 20 soldiers on the M160 route-clearance robot, significantly improving unit proficiency and readiness.
honors.issuer: Issued by Lt. Joseph Chung · Jun 2019
